# Staff SDET / Test Automation Architect — Tyrell Corp

**Location:** Remote (EU) · **Type:** Full-time · **Posted:** 2026-08-26

Tyrell is scaling its engineering org to 200 and needs a staff-level test automation architect to own
quality strategy and the end-to-end test platform.

## Responsibilities

- Design the E2E and API test framework (Playwright, contract tests)
- Own CI test infrastructure, flakiness budgets, and test-data management
- Coach ~15 engineers on testing practice

## Requirements

- 8+ years in test automation, 3+ at staff/architect level
- Deep Playwright or Selenium; strong TypeScript or Python
- Experience building CI test infrastructure from scratch

## Compensation

€115,000–€140,000. Sponsorship available.

Expected triage: **kept** — clear match for the Test Automation direction.
